title: Celestial Library Vision
description: A woman in an ornate patterned gown sits at a stone pedestal table inside a dimly lit room, gazing toward an arched window revealing a cosmic night sky filled with stars, floating books, and glowing scrolls. An open book rests on a wooden chair beside her while mathematical equations and ivy cover the cracked walls under a painted celestial ceiling.
prompt: A mystical woman in an intricate patterned gown sits beside a stone pedestal table inside an old room with cracked walls covered in mathematical equations and ivy. She gazes at a large arched window revealing a starry cosmic sky with floating ancient books, glowing scrolls, and ethereal light beams pouring into the room. An open book lies on an ornate wooden chair nearby, red curtains frame the window, and the ceiling is painted with clouds and stars, surreal fantasy style, detailed, atmospheric lighting
